# Agentic Labs

> Agentic Labs is an enterprise AI consulting firm that designs, ships, and runs custom autonomous AI agents integrated with your systems of record (Salesforce, Workday, Databricks, SAP, NetSuite). Production-ready systems in 6–8 weeks, governed end to end, with an average of $3.2M in client savings across 50+ deployments.

## Solutions
- [Solutions overview](https://agenticlabs.io/solutions): Enterprise AI solutions and services.
- [Intelligent Agents](https://agenticlabs.io/solutions/intelligent-agents): Goal-driven autonomous agents that execute complex workflows across 150+ enterprise apps.
- [Customer Service Automation](https://agenticlabs.io/solutions/customer-service-automation): Unified AI support agents; 60% faster ticket resolution.
- [Document Processing](https://agenticlabs.io/solutions/document-processing): AI extraction, classification, and processing at 94% accuracy.
- [Context Management](https://agenticlabs.io/solutions/context-management): Knowledge graphs, semantic indexing, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) implementation.
- [Agentic Evaluation](https://agenticlabs.io/solutions/agentic-evaluation): Measure AI agent accuracy, task completion, cost-per-action, and business outcomes.
- [AI Governance & Security](https://agenticlabs.io/solutions/ai-governance-security): Bounded autonomy, audit trails, and SOC 2 compliant agents.

## Industries
- [Industries overview](https://agenticlabs.io/industries): Industry-specific agentic automation.
- [Healthcare](https://agenticlabs.io/industries/healthcare): HIPAA-compliant patient intake, clinical documentation, scheduling.
- [Manufacturing](https://agenticlabs.io/industries/manufacturing): Predictive maintenance, quality control, supply chain optimization.
- [Retail](https://agenticlabs.io/industries/retail): Inventory forecasting, customer service, order management.
- [Energy & Utilities](https://agenticlabs.io/industries/energy): Grid optimization, predictive maintenance, demand forecasting.
- [Dealers & Distributors](https://agenticlabs.io/industries/dealers-distributors): Order entry, inventory optimization, quote generation.
- [Power Electronics & FPGA](https://agenticlabs.io/industries/power-electronics-fpga): AI-enhanced EDA for FPGA design and verification.
- [Autonomy & Robotics](https://agenticlabs.io/industries/autonomy-robotics): Vision inspection, autonomous navigation, cobot orchestration.
- [Biotech & Pharma Logistics](https://agenticlabs.io/industries/biotech-pharma-logistics): Cold chain monitoring, compliance documentation, drug discovery.
